Blend segment embeddings with their document context

Source: R/blend.R
blend.Rd

blend() computes context-aware embeddings of segments: it combines what each segment says beyond its parent document with the direction of the document itself. A short segment is often ambiguous on its own ("It was too hard."), and identical segments can occur in different documents with different meanings; the parent document supplies the missing context.

Each segment vector u is split into the part along its unit-length document vector d and the residual orthogonal to it; the blend keeps alpha of the residual and 1 - alpha of the document direction, scaled to unit length: $$m = \mathrm{normalize}\left(\alpha \left(u - (u \cdot d)\, d\right) + (1 - \alpha)\, d\right)$$ with u and d normalized first. alpha = 0 returns the document vector, alpha = 1 only what the segment adds to it. Identical segments from different documents therefore receive different vectors. A segment that points exactly along its document receives the document vector.

The result, a matrix with one unit-length row per segment, replaces the segment embeddings in the embeddings argument of topics(), representatives() and predict(). To cluster segments by their own meaning alone, pass the plain segment embeddings from encode() instead.

Usage

blend(
  segments,
  documents = NULL,
  model = NULL,
  alpha = 0.5,
  embeddings = NULL,
  document_embeddings = NULL,
  batch_size = 32L
)

Arguments

segments

A data frame from segment(), or any data frame with a numeric document_id and a text column, one row per segment.

documents

The character vector of documents that was segmented; document_id indexes it. Needed unless both embedding matrices are given.

model

A model from load_model(), a pinned model name, or NULL (default) for the default model; ignored when embeddings are given.

alpha

Weight of the segment's residual, in [0, 1] (default 0.5).

embeddings

Segment embeddings, one row per row of segments, or NULL (default) to encode them. Give together with document_embeddings.

document_embeddings

Document embeddings, one row per document, or NULL (default) to encode documents.

batch_size

Texts per model call when encoding (default 32).

Value

A numeric matrix with one unit-length row per row of segments and the columns of the embeddings.

Conditions

sbert_bad_input when only one of embeddings and document_embeddings is given, or neither they nor documents; when encoding, the conditions of encode().

See also

segment() for the segments; encode() for the embeddings; topics() to fit topics on the blended vectors.

Examples

segments <- segment("The model works. It is fast.", level = "sentence")
segment_vectors <- matrix(c(1, 0, 0.6, 0.8), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
document_vector <- matrix(c(0, 1), nrow = 1)
blend(segments, embeddings = segment_vectors,
      document_embeddings = document_vector)
#>           [,1]      [,2]
#> [1,] 0.7071068 0.7071068
#> [2,] 0.5144958 0.8574929

# alpha = 0 returns the document vector for every segment.
blend(segments, alpha = 0, embeddings = segment_vectors,
      document_embeddings = document_vector)
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]    0    1
#> [2,]    0    1
